verdict.rationale: The H200 SXM is hardware you can deploy on your own premises: NVIDIA sells it through HGX H200 partner and NVIDIA-Certified Systems with 4 or 8 GPUs. The CUDA Toolkit supports deploying applications in enterprise data centers, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise/NIM microservices support self-managed generative AI deployment. Missing for 10: explicit on-prem installation and operations documentation for SXM/HGX systems, independent hands-on reports of self-hosted (not provider-run) H200 SXM deployments, and SXM-specific confirmation of AI Enterprise inclusion (the subscription is documented for the NVL variant).
